channel.title: AI GridWatch — Georgia data center updates
channel.description: Data center moratoriums, proposals, and community-impact headlines for Georgia, from AI GridWatch.

item.title: Columbia County: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: 180-day moratorium proposed at commission meeting by chair candidate Cambrey Wood; citizens group also presented model ordinance. Would not affect two already-approved data centers. No vote yet

item.title: Walker County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 30-day pause adopted Jul 9, extended unanimously to 180 days on Aug 7 with a data center study group (report due Dec 4, 2026). Unincorporated county only

item.title: Hogansville: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 90-day moratorium on data-center applications, extended 30 days in Jul 2026 (to approximately early Sep 2026) while the city develops a new data-center ordinance with consultant Canvas Planning and a citizen input committee. QTS (Eagle South LLC) has proposed a 600 MW facility

item.title: Cobb County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 180-day moratorium enacted Feb 2026, extended an additional 180 days ~Aug 2026; unincorporated areas only. Ordinance changes in progress

item.title: Athens-Clarke County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Moratorium adopted Dec 2025, extended 3 months in Mar 2026 while an ordinance is drafted. Waiting on state-level legislation before finalising local rules

item.title: Palmetto: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Permanent ban — city council unanimously rewrote the industrial zoning code to exclude data centers entirely

item.title: Hall County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 180-day moratorium on data centers, high-density residential, and detention centers, approved 4-0. Staff examining regulations for impacts on county services and infrastructure

item.title: Coweta County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 180-day moratorium; five previously proposed data centers (including the \$17B Project Sail) are exempt under vested-rights doctrine. Expires Dec 23 or when the board adopts ordinance amendments

item.title: DeKalb County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Extended 6-1 through Mar 30, 2027 — two weeks after the commission rejected the planning department's proposed data center zoning rules, so the pause is now the only thing holding the line

item.title: Paulding County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Suspends new data center applications, zoning requests and civil plan reviews through Dec 31, 2026

item.title: Cherokee County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 30-day pause, with a stated plan to extend it into early 2027 — the short term is procedural, not the real horizon

item.title: Augusta: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Commissioners declined to adopt the proposed data center ordinance and extended the existing moratorium 60 more days instead

item.title: Gordon County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Moratoriums on data centers and anaerobic digestion facilities extended through Jan 29, 2027 while staff drafts ordinances

item.title: Carroll County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 100-day pause on permits for data centers and battery energy storage in unincorporated areas, later extended another 100 days. The current end date is not documented in the coverage read — confirm before citing it as active

item.title: Georgia (HB 1012): data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: Would bar local permits for new data centers until Mar 1, 2027, exempting approvals issued before Jul 1, 2026
